settings.title: Remote Control
settings.intro: Control this host from a remote device through your self-hosted relay. The relay only ever sees end-to-end encrypted traffic.

state.running: Running — waiting for a device to connect.
state.needsRelay: Save a Relay URL in the card above first.
state.off: Off. Turn on to allow remote control.

settings.authTokenPlaceholder: Leave blank to keep the current token
settings.authTokenHint: Stored in the OS keychain, never on disk in cleartext.
settings.deviceNameHint: Lowercase letters, digits and '-' (up to 32). Entered with the master password to sign in to this machine (another Devdy or the web controller) or to join its sync group; the sync group shows this machine under it. Lets several hosts share one relay.
settings.masterPasswordReplace: Enter a new password to replace the current one
settings.masterPasswordSet: Set a password to skip the OTP each time
settings.masterPasswordHint: Enter it on your phone instead of the OTP code, and on another machine joining this one's sync group. Stored in the OS keychain. Fixed — only use it if you are the sole user. Changing or clearing it signs out every device signed in so far.
settings.perRunHint: Remote sessions are now created per run: open a run and click the {remote} button in the toolbar to generate a link. Enter your {masterPassword} (if set) or the OTP code on your phone to connect.
settings.controlOtherHint: Open a window that drives another Devdy over this relay, signed in with its device name and master password.

confirmClearMaster.title: Clear master password
confirmClearMaster.message:
Remove the saved master password?
You will use the per-join OTP code again.

confirmClearAudit.title: Clear audit log
confirmClearAudit.message:
Permanently delete all remote-control audit entries?
This cannot be undone.

toast.deviceNameInvalid: Device name: use only lowercase letters, digits and '-' (up to 32)

identity.title: This device & relay
identity.intro: Shared by Remote Control and Sync. Another Devdy enters this device name and master password both to control this machine and to join its sync group, and the sync group lists this machine under the same name.

session.title: Control from phone
session.heading: Control your runs from your phone
session.scanCaption: Scan with your phone or copy the link to open the controller.
session.cannotDeriveController: Could not determine the controller address from the relay URL. Copy the fields below and paste them into the controller manually.
session.enterMasterOnPhone: Enter the {masterPassword} on your phone to connect. (Set a password in Settings → Remote Control.)
session.enterMasterToFinish: Enter the master password on your phone to finish.
session.phoneControlling: Your phone is paired and can drive any run. Closing this modal will not disconnect.
session.disabledDesc: Remote Control isn't enabled yet. Turn it on to create a link for your phone.
session.disabledNoRelay: Remote Control isn't enabled yet. Configure a relay URL in Settings first, then turn it on.

login.title: Control another Devdy
login.subtitle: Sign in with the other device's name and its Remote Control master password.
login.devicePlaceholder: Leave blank if it has no name
login.deviceInvalid: Device names use only lowercase letters, digits and '-' (up to 32).
login.wrongPassword: Wrong password (or too many tries — wait a few minutes).
login.hostOffline: That Devdy is not reachable: check the device name, and that it is running with Remote Control on and a master password set.
login.network: Could not reach the relay. Check your connection and try again.
login.noRelay: Set a Relay URL in Settings → Remote Control on this machine first.

upload.progressMany: Copying {count} files to the controlled Devdy… {percent}%
upload.failed: Couldn't copy {name} to the controlled Devdy: {error}
upload.folderSkipped: Folders can't be dropped into a controlled Devdy yet ({name}).
